issues.issue: Inherited arXiv 1610.06539 is not the Lopez-Paz/Oquab C2ST paper.
issues.resolution: Correct 1610.06545, accuracy-versus-AUC adaptation and spatial exchangeability caveats recorded.

issues.issue: Geothermal sites and fault-confidence/label distances contaminated a supposedly nuisance-only audit.
issues.resolution: Active whitelist only permits road/claim/acquisition families; legacy scripts/reports retired and preserved for traceability.

issues.issue: MRDS mineral occurrences were labelled historic mining claims.
issues.resolution: Official BLM closed claims used: complete IDs checked, quality prefixes parsed, multiple shells/holes respected, 20 km buffer retained.

issues.issue: Two survey areas, an inferred seam or a constant raster cannot stand in for four operational GeoDAWN blocks.
issues.resolution: Official report/metadata/extent/flight inventories reviewed; coordinate-verified four-block membership remains absent. Full audit cannot pass.

issues.issue: Area2 could overwrite the finer overlapping Area1.
issues.resolution: Area1 priority implemented and regression-tested.

issues.issue: The inherited road mirror is clipped tightly to (-120.0024,37.3641,-116.1415,40.7247). A 20 km seed grid does not recover missing external road geometries.
issues.resolution: New anonymous official county-ZIP acquisition with buffered window is implemented, but push/authentication failure prevented its CI run. Current road diagnostics/residualized experiment remain explicitly provisional; nearest-road boundary coverage is not certified.

issues.issue: Masked known predictions could earn TP credit on adjacent new truth; catalogue truth masking was inconsistent.
issues.resolution: Both exact and binary DTI now mask predictions and truth regardless of legacy flag. Adjacent-new-truth and randomized parity tests pass.

issues.issue: Re-thinning/re-ranking binary submissions, zero-budget -0 slicing and arbitrary zero backfill invalidated inherited promotion claims.
issues.resolution: True four-arm refitting, as-emitted historical diagnostics, deterministic positive-only top budgets and explicit current-best reconstruction veto.

issues.issue: Zero-padded quadrants or zeroing catalogue pixels before NMS could create artificial boundary/flank ridges.
issues.resolution: Complete predicted halos and valid-support erosion; catalogue exclusion only after NMS; boundary tests pass.

issues.issue: An exact-candidate torus shift produced a single-class held-out fold, for which AUC is undefined.
issues.resolution: Geometry/cohort support only determines retry; no statistic-based exclusion. Every rejected draw is recorded; retries bounded; 99 valid shifts required. Shift inference is conditional and diagnostic, not an exact spatial null. Grouped primary remains unchanged.

issues.issue: Original H19 OOF caches and source-to-artifact reconstruction are unavailable.
issues.resolution: Current H19 output diagnostics are scored as emitted and used only as a conservative veto. No certified win over the original current-best holdout or new public score is claimed.

issues.issue: H19 comments call four heavily shared-input lines independent and contain old budget-only descriptions alongside changed weight code.
issues.resolution: Actual reviewed coefficients and shared terrain inputs documented; measured Jaccard .777234. Score differences and code coefficients are not causal ablations.

issues.issue: Annular coherence can respond to intrusion rims, erosion and locally tangent sharp contacts; it is not unique to ring faults.
issues.resolution: Synthetic specificity-limit test added; first feature/run retained unchanged. No discovery or angular-coverage correction is silently claimed after observing folds.

issues.issue: The initial preregistration fixes transforms/splits/budget/gates but does not enumerate every numeric HGB/residualizer setting.
issues.resolution: Settings were fixed in implementation before first fit and no outer-fold search occurred; preregistration completeness is not overstated or retroactively rewritten.

issues.issue: Owner-mirror integrity does not independently authenticate organizer bytes or every original band alias.
issues.resolution: Full hashes/provenance caveat retained; ambiguous tc/earthquake aliases excluded. Do not claim all physical semantics independently verified.

issues.issue: Official metadata has <class 'str'> placeholders, a Winnemucca title for a full-survey extent, and 151799 line-km versus 149030 in the contractor report.
issues.resolution: Different accounting is possible but unverified; no boundaries or calibration inferred from the discrepancies.

issues.issue: Portal [0,1] rejection and weak source/grid/content-ID/ZIP checks.
issues.resolution: Finite [0,1] in-footprint writer; strict organizer-grid validation; full source checksum; soft-float32 content identity; one flat TIFF ZIP and separate <=200-character note. Reference and fallback both checked; portal upload itself not tested.

issues.issue: Owner artifact reports, stale site claims and public account bests could be conflated.
issues.resolution: 0.1922 original reference is owner-reported; official leader .3195 is timestamped; unknown scores remain unknown; no artifact-linked official receipt invented.

issues.issue: gh REST/GraphQL returned 401 and git push lacked usable credentials.
issues.resolution: GitHub reconnection in Arena requested, without requesting secrets. Work saved locally on the fixed session branch. No PR, merge, buffered-road CI run or public deployment claimed.

issues.issue: Full uncondensed original chat text was unavailable in the continuation.
issues.resolution: Inherited quoted owner charter retained verbatim and all available active constraints expanded in README; no claim to reproduce unseen text word for word.

issues.issue: Rules and platform present different deadline time conventions.
issues.resolution: Latest organizer guidance must be confirmed; no assumed conversion or cutoff is stated.
